messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Poisson hurdle model
parts:
See the spde manual for how to use a different binomial process for the zeros

Inf in this setting is usually due to a near singular model so the uncertainty in the linear predictor creates overflow

H

On Jul 27, 2017, 06:03 +0200, Ruby Ji <crysta...@gmail.com>, wrote:
I have a catch data with a plenty of zero values, so I built a Poisson Hurdle model using "zeroinflatedpoisson0". However, in this way, I can't assign different covariates to the binary process and the positive catch process. To solve this problem, I build a Poisson Hurdle with Probability Model. The probability follows binomial distribution, and the positive catch follows type 0 zero inflated poisson distribution. And each part has different covariates. 

But I can't get the DIC value from Poisson Hurdle with Probability Model. It shows "Inf". So I can't decide which one is better. Any idea on it? 

I will be grateful for any help you can provide.

--
